long_biography.plain_text:
Tomislav Debeljak grew up around the Samobor workshop where his father, Božidar, made fasteners. He helped in the business as a child and gradually assumed responsibility as it moved from a garage craft operation into industrial production. By 2007, he was managing DIV Group's operations.

Under Debeljak, the group broadened beyond bolts through a Knin fastener factory, Serbian rail-infrastructure manufacturing, steel structures and construction. DIV Group acquired Brodosplit in 2013, adding commercial and specialised shipbuilding to the portfolio. This expansion makes manufacturing the clearest source and current focus of his wealth, with shipbuilding one branch of a wider industrial group. Debeljak chairs DIV Group's management board and remains an active operator rather than a passive family shareholder. The original business and succession were family-based, while the later factories, acquisitions and diversification reflect his own stewardship. DIV Group and its subsidiaries own their factories, shipyards, equipment, contracts and other assets; those corporate holdings should not be treated as Debeljak's personal property.
